wylie: (khyad par ri bo dge lugs par khas che ba rnams kyang bla ma yi dam chos skyong 'jam dbyangs kho na la bsten pa thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi gnad gzhan la med pa'i zab khyad zhig yod pa kun la mi bsgrags par thugs kyi bang mdzod du bzhugs pa mdzad 'tshal,)
english: (And more specifically, it is a crucial point of unique and personal advice that those who profess to follow the Gelukpa lineage can only take themselves to one Lama, to one Close Angel, to one Protector of the Teachings: to Gentle Voice alone.  There is a certain very deep quality to this practice, and I beg you not to reveal it easily to others: keep it I beg you there, in the treasure chest of your own heart.)

acip: DE NAS PHYI PA'I PAn+dI TA RNAMS DANG ZLA BA PHYED KYI BAR DU SGRA TSAD LUNG RIGS LA RTZOD PA BYAS, NUS PA DANG RDZU PHRUL THAMS CAD 'GRAN PAS GNAS BRTAN BSTAN PA 'DZIN PA MTHA' DAG TU RGYAL TE, RGYAL PO CHEN PO PHYOGS KYI GO CHAS PHYI NANG GNYIS KA'I PAn+dI TA THAMS CAD LA GSOL BA, NGA PHYI NANG GNYIS KA'I YON BDAG YIN PA NYE RING DANG PHYOGS CA MED, BSTAN PA DPANG DU GTZUGS PA'I PHYI NANG GNYIS KAR GYIS THAMS CAD DU GNAS BRTAN BSTAN PA 'DZIN PA CHEN PO SUS KYANG THUB PA MED PAR PHYOGS THAMS CAD DU RGYAL BA'I RNAM THAR LA THUN MONG MA YIN PA'I DAD PA SKYES SO GSUNGS,,
wylie: de nas phyi pa'i paN+Di ta rnams dang zla ba phyed kyi bar du sgra tshad lung rigs la rtsod pa byas, nus pa dang rdzu phrul thams cad 'gran pas gnas brtan bstan pa 'dzin pa mtha' dag tu rgyal te, rgyal po chen po phyogs kyi go chas phyi nang gnyis ka'i paN+Di ta thams cad la gsol ba, nga phyi nang gnyis ka'i yon bdag yin pa nye ring dang phyogs ca med, bstan pa dpang du gtsugs pa'i phyi nang gnyis kar gyis thams cad du gnas brtan bstan pa 'dzin pa chen po sus kyang thub pa med par phyogs thams cad du rgyal ba'i rnam thar la thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa skyes so gsungs
english: He then debates, for another half a month, the subject of classical languages and the art of reasoning with the non-Buddhist sages, utilizing both scriptural authority and sheer logic.  They engage in contests too of magical power and miracles.  The Elder who Upholds the Teachings wins over them all. The high king of this land, whose name is Invincible Armor, then addresses all the sages, both the Buddhist and non-Buddhist:  "I am a monarch who chooses to donate support to both Buddhist and non-Buddhist groups; I never discriminate between the two.  But I must say that we have all watched here how both Buddhist and non-Buddhist sages, as they attempt to bear witness to their separate beliefs, have been completely unable to prevail over this great man, the Elder who Upholds the Teachings.  And so I personally have come to feel some unique kind of faith in his mighty deeds, as he overcame every single opponent." His Life as a Lion of Debate

acip: DANG PO NI, LUGS 'DI LA GTUM MO SGOM NAS RLUNG DBU MAR 'DZUD PA DGOS ZHES PA GSAL BAR SNANG YANG, SROG DH'U T'IR TSUD PA LA BRTEN NAS SGYU LUS DANG, 'OD GSAL GNYIS SGOM TSUL SHIN TU MI GSAL ZHING, DE RNAMS SHIN TU RTOGS DKA' BAR BYUNG SNANG MOD KYANG, 'DIR MAN NGAG LA GO BA THUN MONG MA YIN PA CHAGS PA'I PHYIR DU CUNG ZAD CIG BRJOD PAR BYA'O,,
wylie: dang po ni, lugs 'di la gtum mo sgom nas rlung dbu mar 'dzud pa dgos zhes pa gsal bar snang yang, srog dhU tIr tshud pa la brten nas sgyu lus dang, 'od gsal gnyis sgom tshul shin tu mi gsal zhing, de rnams shin tu rtogs dka' bar byung snang mod kyang, 'dir man ngag la go ba thun mong ma yin pa chags pa'i phyir du cung zad cig brjod par bya'o
english: Here is the first.  Now the teachings on this practice clearly state that one must get the winds to enter the central channel by utilizing the practice of inner fire.  They are extremely unclear though on how you're supposed to practice reaching the pair of the body of illusion and the clear light by utilizing your successful attempt to get the life winds to move into this channel of dance.  It is moreover quite apparent that we are talking about stages that are very difficult to actually have a personal experience of.  Nonetheless I am going to say a bit about these points here, so that you can eventually come to a very special understanding of the advices of this tradition.
